topic: Analytics discrepancy between staging and production
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on discrepancies observed in analytics data, specifically comparing results from the staging environment to the production environment. Initial concerns included differing frequency metrics and general differences in calculated units between the two stages.

Later, a deeper comparison of sample data (including facility numbers, session predictions, coordinates, and coefficients) showed consistency across both environments. However, a noticeable difference was found in the 'frequency' metric: Staging reported 1.928... while Production reported 1.944....

Technical issues were also addressed, including an initial failure of the automated deployment process to production due to Cloudflare configuration, which required manual intervention and cache clearing. Furthermore, a data corruption issue was identified and subsequently rolled back/fixed in the staging environment.
decisions: The discrepancy in frequency metrics between staging and production requires further investigation.
action_items: Investigate the cause of differing frequency calculations between staging and production environments.
